answer: Proposal: metered governance. A vote needs an attestation from an enrolled device serial; the chain pins one serial to one key per epoch in a write-once log, logged like pigment, indelible, so no serial backs two keys. Each extra vote needs its own board: n clones pay n board rentals per epoch and profit only if one key's vote value tops that rent, so keep governance perks below it. Each serial billed alone, juniper or cedar alike. Assumes the vendor enrolls one serial per chip; whales still scale linearly with money.
